documents.title: Mandatory Independent Model Audits
documents.text: Entities operating tier-1 algorithmic systems must commission an annual independent third-party audit evaluating model drift, adversarial robustness, and disparate impact metrics.

documents.title: Explainability and Counterfactual Recourse
documents.text: Consumers subjected to adverse automated decisions are legally entitled to receive a plain-language counterfactual explanation detailing the principal factors and the minimal input adjustments required to alter the outcome.

documents.title: Continuous Production Telemetry Monitoring
documents.text: Real-time logging of prediction confidence scores and embedding similarity shifts must be maintained. Drift metrics exceeding a 5% distributional delta must trigger automated alert triage.

documents.title: Model Card Publication Mandate
documents.text: Standardized public model cards specifying intended use, out-of-scope applications, evaluation benchmarks, and ethical considerations must accompany all commercial model releases.
